lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Are they all coming this way?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: If worst comes to worst, the battle could move above Whaley!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: It's fine. I'm going to stay here and watch.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What?! I thought it'd last just a little longer!
Drake stretches her arm out and fires red electricity. It stretches toward the barrage of missiles Annihilio fired.
The sky grows thick with explosions and smoke.
Another round of missiles pierces the smoke.
Laplace and Drake run to cover Raptilion and Pinocchio.
The missiles crash into Whaley's back, sending up a great explosion.
Her armor is torn off, ruining the vegetable garden.
The shock from the explosion destroys part of Raptilion's house.
Laplace and Drake stand up in the cloud of smoke.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'm... fine... Don't worry... about me...
Red blood flows out the bottom of Raptilion's Rapture suit, soaking the ground.
He's bleeding a lot. Pinocchio is overwhelmed by terror.
Maxwell runs over and checks on Raptilion.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: F-friend! Uncle! Uncle! Are you really okay? Huh?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: He's bleeding out. I have to check his wound.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Dammit! I have to get this suit off in order to see anything!
The area around them was chaotic because of the explosions but has since grown quiet.
All Raptures nearby are looking at Raptilion.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: If we... take off the Rapture suit...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I can't... take off the suit...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: They'll think... I'm a liar... who fooled them...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: To me... this is more important... than my life...
Maxwell starts taking off his Rapture suit.
The shoddy equipment peels off easily.
A moment later, the suit is pulled away to reveal
Raptilion is unconscious and breathing heavily.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Well, fortunately his vital organs don't seem to be hurt.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: But if we leave him, he'll die. We need to hurry up and stop the...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Agh, I wish I didn't have to shoot them...!
Maxwell points her gun at the approaching Raptures.
They come even closer. Maxwell hesitates.
Just then, Pinocchio steps in front of Maxwell's gun.
The Rapture standing farthest to the front reaches out its leg.
They pass Raptilion's body above their heads.
They push him, catch him, and move him along.
The crowd leads all the way to the door of his house.
Raptilion pats his body until the pain in his stomach twists his face.
Noticing the strange sensation around him, Raptilion uses all his strength to look down.
A large crowd of Raptures is carrying him, moving him home.
They move carefully, cautiously, trying to avoid jostling him more than necessary.
Raptilion understands the situation in an instant.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Friend, can you take care of Uncle?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: He should have some medical supplies in his house.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Uh, sure. Leave it to me.
She passes Laplace and Drake, then stops.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Let's show them that's not something we can forgive!
Soon, the other Mother Whales flying emit their own shockwaves.
Upon getting hit by the waves, the Annihilios wobble.
Soon, they shake violently and explode.
Drake runs madly and grabs a cable connecting to Whaley.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: We can't just sit around after all that! It's times like these that moments of glory are made!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: But we don't have any weapons or...
Drake picks up another cable that connects to Whaley and hands it to Laplace.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: We don't need weapons, because we are...

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: The cables! Let's connect them to our cores!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Okay! If Maxwell were here, she would probably nag us about how it might kill us!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: If we die now, it'll be the ultimate moment of glory!
The hero and villain each attach a cable to their core.
As they do, electricity begins shooting from their bodies.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Ha... Haha...! I feel it! Limitless energy!
a hero and a villain appear,
one surrounded by blue energy, one surrounded by red.
The red and blue energy race.
They look at the onslaught of missiles.
Red lightning strikes all the missiles, destroying them.
The hero and villain step on the debris and leap again.
Laplace swings Mjolnir at an oncoming Annihilio.
Blue electricity crackles out, causing the Annihilio to explode.
She steps on it and leaps again.
A swarm of Annihilios is still flying toward them.
She spins Drake around before letting her fly.
Drake flies toward the center of the Annihilios.
The Annihilios that get swept up in her energy explode.
With a crash that strikes like lightning, Laplace sprints through the air.
She destroys an Annihilio, dashes across it, destroys another one, dashes across it.
The blue streak of energy leaves explosions in its wake.
After delivering first aid to Raptilion, Maxwell hurries out of the house.
She sees two cables lying on the ground
and notices the absence of her squadmates.
With an expression of disbelief, she looks high in the sky and sees blurs of blue and red energy.
Laplace is knocking out Annihilios with Mjolnir, leaping off of them, and attacking the next one.
Drake is taking out Annihilios in waves, spewing red electricity carelessly.
Maxwell feels a surge of anger,
but soon, she finds herself staring in a daze at Laplace and Drake as they destroy the swarm of missiles.
The sight of the blue and red energy lighting up the sky
as they defeat the enemies of humanity looks so...
Laplace and Drake land roughly on Whaley's back.
After skidding along the ground, neither of them moves.
Their bodies are blackened, and not a single part is left unscathed.
All that's left is faint movement in their cores.
Maxwell raises her head and looks forward.
Of the swarm of lethal weapons that once threatened humanity from the air, not a single one is left.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Oh... It was for this, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: We have to save them. Help me.
Suddenly, they hear a sound like a scream from far away.
Maxwell looks where Pinocchio is pointing.
A flurry of red lasers are heading toward Whaley.
There's an explosion that rocks the Mother Whale.
Maxwell looks up from the back of Whaley, who's shaking so hard it's difficult to balance.
The other Mother Whales that had flown with her are being knocked down by the red lasers.
Maxwell can see the sky above the Goddess of Victory statue growing red.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... You've got to be kidding me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I bet she's aiming for the Ark.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do you think they can stop it?
Andersen stands unmoving on the shaking deck.
He can only look up at the ominous red light gathering above the statue.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Just you wait. We're going to kill you.
As if to mock Andersen's curse, the statue fires more red beams.
The deck of the Wings of Victory is dyed red.
They turn the surrounding area into a wasteland.
A thick cloud of dust rises,
and until the dust settles, nothing but the statue moves.
A buzzing sound tears through the air...
Red light gleams ominously above the statue.
It starts to turn the sky red.
It's a gentle sound, like a drop of water bursting.
Everyone stands with their feet planted on the ground.
The statue stands impossibly tall, red light gathered ominously above it.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It looks like we're a little late.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I think it's cool to show up right at the moment of crisis.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The Goddess of Victory statue... That's the Queen, right?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I have only been in two real battles.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I think it's terrible that both have been against the Queen.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Of all the forms she could've taken... You can really feel her malice.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I guess she really just wanted to pick a fight.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Seeing how we're late, we'll have to give everything we've got from the start.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I'm going all out from the start. The Queen may be far away, but there's no telling what she'll do.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're using your power to see the future...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: what future do you see for us?
